scope: Complete selected native code-load records only; incomplete file suffixes retained as explicit metadata. These static code regions may contain alignment/data and are not dynamic instructions, cache costs, spills or acceptance timings. Code-load logging can repeat shared code; load-event counts are not compilation counts. perf-prof disables code-space compaction according to V8 flag definitions, so diagnostic address/layout is not assumed identical to an uninstrumented browser.
